intent: Target architecture contract only. Current Dockerfiles are unchanged in this audit PR.

current.description: Inference and training dependencies currently live in the same retained image.

shared_requirements: Shared means identical base layer digests, not merely matching CUDA version strings.
PyTorch CUDA wheels cannot be removed or substituted until runtime ABI/CUDA/cuDNN validation proves compatibility.
Do not change the production dependency-stage commands before verifying image size and GPU functionality.
Do not put user datasets, training checkpoints or persistent jobs inside the image or an ephemeral build layer.
Make inference and trainer siblings, not trainer FROM inference; otherwise the training image carries PaddlePaddle unnecessarily.
Train using an isolated worker and share only specifically mounted user-data directories; keep review/training progress, cancellation and ONNX export validation.
Only purge build-only files inside the step that introduces them or copy selected artifacts into a new stage.
Preserve existing installed CUDA images and build cache until a tested replacement is available.
